commitResults.messageTitle: README: Update references from Duke to Lune
commitResults.messageBody:
The project and class were renamed from Duke to Lune earlier, but the
README/docs/README instructions and sample output still referenced the
old name and banner text.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add present-changes-visually and test-ui Claude Code skills, plus a UI test plan
commitResults.messageBody:
present-changes-visually (adapted from se-edu/skill-present-changes-visually)
generates a self-contained HTML side-by-side diff for reviewing changes.

test-ui runs the console test cases recorded in test/ui-test-plan.md against
the compiled program, comparing actual output to expected output per case,
and stopping immediately with an expected-vs-actual report on the first
failure. test/ui-test-plan.md currently has 14 cases covering the greet/exit,
todo/deadline/event, mark/unmark/delete, and error-handling behavior added so
far, including several that specifically interleave valid and invalid input
to catch bugs that only corrupt internal state (task numbering, done status)
rather than crashing outright.

commitResults.messageTitle: Handle more edge cases and errors
Extract TaskList class to hold the task list
commitResults.messageBody:
Working toward the Ui/Storage/Parser/TaskList decomposition target,
starting with TaskList since it's the lowest-risk extraction: a pure
data wrapper around the existing ArrayList<Task>, with no dependency
on how errors get printed (unlike Storage) or how parsing/execution
get split (unlike Parser/Ui). It implements Iterable<Task> so callers
never need to reach into the underlying ArrayList directly.

Lune.java now holds a TaskList instead of an ArrayList<Task> directly;
processCommand() and saveTasks() take a TaskList parameter. Since
TaskList exposes the same method names (add/remove/get/size) plus
Iterable, the call sites inside processCommand needed no changes.
loadTasks() still returns ArrayList<Task> for now, wrapped into a
TaskList at the call site in main() — aligning it with a Storage class
is next iteration's job, not this one.

No behavior change: all 24 cases in test/ui-test-plan.md still pass.
